metadata.name: entry
metadata.description: marker cel: its presence makes origin.launch run the settle loop that materializes the desktop chrome + taskbar genesis.

metadata.name: iconpos
metadata.description: per-label icon positions { label: [x,y] }. Seeded empty so desktop.iconbar.frame's dep edge is LIVE from hydrate — else a drag (setValue iconpos) wouldn't re-render the icon (it'd teleport on drop). Unpositioned icons now fill top-to-bottom and wrap into new columns automatically (desktop.icons availH), so no manual second-column seed is needed; a dragged icon adds its own [x,y] entry here.

metadata.name: wallpaper
metadata.description: the current wallpaper src (OPFS /path or data-URI); empty falls back to the shipped windows.wallpaper. Seeded so desktop.bg.frame's dep edge is live (a settings change repaints reactively).

metadata.name: bg.frame
metadata.description: self-mounting wallpaper; right-click opens display settings. Falls back to the shipped windows.wallpaper when desktop.wallpaper is unset.

metadata.name: iconbar.frame
metadata.description: self-mounting app launcher: draggable desktop icons (non-mobile) or the collapsible nav (mobile). Sheet creates a new worksheet doc (do:origin.newsheet); Files/DOOM are origin-applications (app:); readme/keyboard/turtles are sheetapp origin-USER documents opened via doc: → origin.opendoc.

cels.f: =mount('.origin', desktop.icons(desktop.iconpos, viewport.mobile, viewport.h - 44, item('▣ Origin', '元'), item('田 Sheet', 'do:origin.newsheet'), item('📁 Files', 'app:filesapp'), item('📖 Readme', 'doc:readme'), item('🎹 Keyboard', 'doc:keyboard'), item('💬 Chatrooms', 'doc:chatrooms'), item('📊 Turtles', 'doc:turtle_charts'), item('📋 Kanban', 'doc:kanban'), item('🐟 10k Boids', 'doc:boids10k'), item('🦠 Life', 'doc:life'), item('🐠 Boids', 'doc:boids'), item('🕵️ ChaosEdgeSteg', 'doc:chaosedgesteg'), item('🕵️ NanoSteg', 'doc:nanostegapp'), item('🐢 DOOM', 'app:doomapp'), item('👤 Profile', 'doc:identity')))

metadata.name: graph.frame
metadata.description: self-mounting round lower-left button → the state force-graph.

metadata.name: taskbar.sync
metadata.description: genesis-from-formula: re-derives desktop.taskbar.frame from win.list/win.active so the bottom taskbar tracks open/active/minimized windows reactively.

metadata.name: update.frame
metadata.description: self-mounting update-notice chip (fixed top-right): renders nothing while origin.update is {} — boot's origin.updateCheck fills it when the page's baked build id (#plastron-update) differs from the persisted last-seen id (/plastron/update-seen). Click opens the what's-new window (origin.updateOpen); Later/Refresh persist the seen id.

manifests.name: desktop
manifests.description: the origin desktop shell (wallpaper, icons, taskbar, state graph)
